map.输入学生成绩，自动计算均分、最高/最低分、标准差、及格率、优秀率，生成分数段分布: Input student scores; auto-compute mean, highest/lowest, standard deviation, pass rate, excellence rate, and generate score-band distribution and ranking.
map.班级/年级成绩批量统计：粘贴全班分数（逗号或换行分隔），工具一次性给出人数、均值: Batch statistics for class/grade scores: paste the whole class scores (comma or newline separated); the tool gives count, mean, standard deviation, highest/lowest and pass/excellence rates at once, avoiding per-person calculation.
map.分段分布与教学诊断：按满分比例划分 90/80/70/60 各段人数，快速定位薄: Segmented distribution and teaching diagnosis: divide counts by full-mark ratio into 90/80/70/60 bands to quickly locate weak score bands, aiding review and remediation.
map.不同满分制兼容：满分非 100（如 120/150）时，按及格线/优秀线百分比自: Compatibility with different full-mark scales: when the full mark is not 100 (e.g. 120/150), the pass/excellence line is auto-converted by percentage to avoid manual conversion errors.
map.算例：8 人成绩 88/92/76/65/95/58/83/70，满分100、及: Example: 8 people's scores 88/92/76/65/95/58/83/70, full mark 100, pass 60%, excellence 85%
map.标准差反映成绩的离散程度（此处为总体标准差 σ=√(Σ(x−均值)²/n)）；值: Standard deviation reflects the dispersion of scores (here population standard deviation sigma=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/n)); larger means bigger gaps and clearer polarization among students, smaller means more balanced overall; it is an important statistic for diagnosing class polarization.
map.及格率/优秀率怎么算才对？: How to correctly compute pass rate / excellence rate?
map.及格率=达到及格线人数÷总人数×100%，优秀率同理；关键是及格/优秀分数线要按: Pass rate = number reaching pass line / total x 100%, excellence rate similarly; the key is to convert the pass/excellence line by the full-mark scale (line percentage x full mark), not fixed 60/85 points - at full mark 150 the pass line is 90. This tool auto-converts by full mark.
